title: Lanes merge their own PRs and the combine train runs too: both together
ruling: Owner's words, verbatim, 11:15 CST Nov 15, via the consultant (ruling own-consultant-speaks-for-owner; typos kept): "the combines by hand r definitely probs right j think ure misunderstanding by saying it's x or y and im saying x and y together is best". Question this answers: lane self-merge (ruling own-lanes-merge-claude-settings-prs) versus the combine train (rulings own-rolling-combine-train, own-combine-tournament-idea, own-826-a-now-build-b): one or the other. The owner's answer: both together, not either. || The consultant's and triage's reading, not the owner's: lanes merge their own PRs, and the combine train runs at the same time, combining what queues behind CI. || Coordinator 11:19 CST (relayed, not read by triage): the consultant's reading of 11:18 CST, replacing its 11:15 reading (that a lane marks via `merge --ready` then `--confirm`), is that a lane never marks its own PR ready: runner 10 marks, runner 10 keeps the CI slot, and a lane merges on 'marked and green'. Relayed to runner 10 and the lanes. Lane PRs waiting for a slot: #3499 and #3497. || Unasked: what the combine train combines when a lane has already merged its own PR; who holds the CI slot when a lane and the train both want it (the reading says runner 10).
quote: the combines by hand r definitely probs right j think ure misunderstanding by saying it's x or y and im saying x and y together is best
source: Owner's words, 11:15 CST Nov 15, relayed verbatim by the consultant; the readings are the consultant's and the coordinator's (11:19, relayed), not the owner's.
supersedes_none: It adds to ruling own-lanes-merge-claude-settings-prs (who merges) and to the three combine rulings (what runs behind CI) and answers neither question again: it says both stand together. own-826-a-now-build-b (per-lane now, switch to the train only when its numbers beat per-lane) is the nearest; the owner's 'together' may soften its switch rule, but the words do not say so, so nothing is superseded.
